scope: All 239 local normalized inventory entries and 330 provider rows were structurally compared. Official upstream documents were read for suspected duplicates and semantic counterexamples. This is not a pixel-equivalence certification or full 330-provider implementation audit.

recommendedConsolidations.qualification: Both inventory entries are parts; the common library row should retain part kind and provider trigger APIs. This must not be treated as equivalent to FileInput or DropZone.

conditionalConsolidations.reason: Both indicate indefinite loading, but Spinner is one rotational appearance while Mantine Loader also has bars and dots.
conditionalConsolidations.qualification: Only consolidate into a Loading/Loader library row when oval/spinner/bars/dots stay explicit selectable designs. Keep distinct current entries until those choices exist.

conditionalConsolidations.reason: All expose segmented code entry, but code length, masking, character acceptance, grouping and completion behaviors differ.
conditionalConsolidations.qualification: Group as code-input templates only after provider-specific masking, length, pattern and form behavior are represented. Current unsupported placeholder equality is not proof of interchangeability.

conditionalConsolidations.reason: Both present supplementary hover previews, but Base UI has destination-link semantics and a strict non-interactive popup contract.
conditionalConsolidations.qualification: A common Preview visual grouping is possible with separate provider behavior. Do not merge their runtime contracts; React Aria PreviewTrigger is explicitly excluded because it supports keyboard/touch interaction.

keepDistinct.reason: Input is the raw styled input primitive. TextField/TextInput include label, description, errors and accessible linking. Mantine explicitly differentiates these.

Mantine Dialog has no focus trap or overlay and differs from Modal; AlertDialog is urgent decision flow; Drawer is gesture/edge-driven, Sheet is an edge dialog composition. Same broad role is insufficient.
Accordion coordinates multiple regions; Collapsible is a single trigger/panel; Collapse animates presence without owning a disclosure trigger; Spoiler clips content by height.

React Aria PreviewTrigger permits hover/focus/long-press and Tab into interactive content. Base UI PreviewCard and Mantine HoverCard are supplementary visual previews; Tooltip is passive description and Popover is a general popup.
Autocomplete accepts free text suggestions; Combobox is a composed query-choice system; Select commits a choice; NativeSelect uses an OS/browser menu; ListBox exposes the option list itself.

Checkbox set membership, radio exclusivity, immediate switch state and pressed toggle action are different contracts. Mantine Chip is a styled checkbox/radio input despite current Axiom toggle mapping.
CheckboxGroup permits independent selections, RadioGroup enforces one selection, SegmentedControl is a styled single radio selection, ToggleGroup may allow zero/single/multiple pressed items.
Scroller adds horizontal navigation controls; ScrollArea owns a scroll viewport and custom scrollbar; Marquee auto-advances; MessageScroller follows appended chat content.
Data Table adds sorting, selection, filtering and pagination to table structure; the plain Table supplies semantic table markup.
Paper is a low-level surface, Card composes content sections, Item is a row/content-action composition, and Empty communicates missing data.
Shared button role does not erase icon-only sizing, close affordance, clipboard action or intentionally unstyled foundation.
Each edits a different color space/channel or combines controls; ColorInput adds a picker to text input whereas ColorField is text color entry. Same generic preview is a fidelity bug.
Single/range numeric selection, discrete star rating and angular input need distinct geometry and value behavior.
Progress tracks a task; Meter measures a scalar; ring/semicircle carry distinct radial geometry and multi-segment designs; NavigationProgress is a global service.
Badge is display, Pill is a token fragment, TagGroup is a selected-item collection, PillsInput is an input composition, TagsInput permits creation, MultiSelect selects from choices.

Calendar view, inline selection, input+popup, segmented/text date fields and ranges are distinct. Same DatePicker name already spans different provider structures and needs provider variant separation.
Segmented time editing, native/text field, popup picker, formatted time display and time grid are not interchangeable.
These encode different layout constraints despite shared div-based structure; canonical renderer equality must not collapse them.
Navigation links, interactive tree selection, popup tree choice and successive nested menus have different keyboard and selection contracts.
Toast service/queue, individual dismissible notification, inline alert and positioned status marker have different lifetimes and ownership.
Text, semantic heading, prose stylesheet, inline/preformatted code, search marking, quotation and keyboard hint must keep their structure and typography.
A command list component and a global keyboard-triggered command palette can share a preview but differ in overlay/hotkey lifecycle.
Floating contextual action bar, visual button grouping and keyboard-coordinated toolbar are not equivalent.
A context-click/long-press origin and a persistent horizontal menu bar are distinct from a triggered action menu; only Menu/DropdownMenu should share one library entry.
Image content, identity fallback, decorative background, color display and icon surface serve distinct visual/semantic roles.
Field and Fieldset have labeling/validation scopes, Label names a control, InputGroup composes adornments, Group is provider-dependent and Form manages submission.
